text_block_list.text:
Some time after her debut, Air Groove 
remained wholly dedicated to student 
council duties, looking after her juniors, 
and above all, pursuing her own ideals.

Meanwhile, placing full trust in the 
"Empress," her Trainer selects the Hanshin 
Juvenile Fillies as the most fitting stage 
for her next race.

Air Groove, too, wished to enter the 
Hanshin JF.

Their goals aligned. Aiming to become the 
Junior queens, the two take off running 
toward their ambition.
